bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears made headlines by agreeing to a trade with the Atlanta Falcons, acquiring a 2027 fifth-round pick and defensive back Clark Phillips III in exchange for defensive lineman Gervon Dexter Sr., pending physicals. The move came alongside several other roster moves as the Chicago Bears on Sunday made several roster moves to comply with the NFL's mandatory 53-man roster limit ahead of the 2026 season opener.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions announced 14 additions to their initial practice squad on Monday as the team finalized its roster ahead of the 2026 season. The Lions also made roster moves, placing RB Isiah Pacheco on Reserve/Injured, signing TE Tyler Conklin to the active roster, and adding OG Elijah Klein and WR Dominic Lovett to the practice squad.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Packers finalized their 53-man roster after a shocking preseason finale victory over the Cardinals, with undrafted rookie WR J. Michael Sturdivant making the cut to extend the team's remarkable streak of keeping an undrafted rookie every year.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings made notable roster moves this week as they finalized their 53-man roster for the 2026 season, keeping QB Max Brosmer on the squad while also naming Brett Thorson as the team's next punter . In free agency and trade news, the Vikings are reportedly set to sign linebacker Kyle Van Noy, while also trading former Vikings offensive tackle Walter Rouse to the New England Patriots
